name: cl_am_disp15_plain_10to11

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20 (lens morning): the owner's 15-minute displacement, 10:00-11:00, with NO side gate (the simplest version). Cause: once the opening half-hour's two-sided auction is over, a 15-minute candle 1.5 ATR long is size bought or sold at any price, and the side caught against it has to cover into the follow-through.

entry.words: From 10:00 to 11:00 ET, a 15-minute candle whose body is at least 1.5 x ATR(14) of the candles before it is a displacement. Enter at its close in its direction: green long, red short. Stop at the displacement candle's other extreme, target 1:1. One trade a day.

taught: [owner 2026-10-15, sheet displace_ema15_1r_10to11_k1p5] displacement = body >= k x ATR(14) of the candles before, followed at its close
[owner 2026-10-15, same sheet] stop = the displacement candle's other extreme; target 1:1; one trade a day
[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] no side gate at all (the EMA20 gate dropped); k 1.5; entries 10:00-11:00 on 15-minute bars
not_run: WINDOW: decisions at the 15-minute closes 10:00, 10:15, 10:30 and 10:45; the nyam pass ends 11:00.
THE CAP: the first displacement of the window is the trade; one a day.
A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
